{{SW|url=news/marvel-star-wars-may-2022-exclusive-preview|text=A Tale from Obi-Wan's Youngling Days and More from Marvel's May 2022 ''Star Wars'' Comics &ndash; Exclusive Preview}} establishes that the frame story in [[Obi-Wan 1|''Obi-Wan'' 1]] takes place during [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]]'s final [[Standard day|days]] on [[Tatooine]], meaning it is set soon before the events of {{Film|IV}}. As ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of ''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]'', which days before ''A New Hope'', to [[1 BBY]]. Therefore, the frame story of [[Star Wars: Obi-Wan (comic series)|Obi-Wan]] must occur in 1 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]].<noinclude>
